description: All-in-one marketing platform with funnels, email, courses and a public API plus MCP server.
auth_notes: Public API keys created in account settings (optional expiry); a separate MCP key is used for the MCP server.
gate_detail: Keys are created by the user under Settings > MCP & API keys. Sources state MCP access is on all plans including Free; the plan requirement for the public API itself is not stated. No sandbox described.
api_scope: Public API covers contacts, tags, custom fields, newsletters, funnels, price plans, courses, automation rules, subscriptions, webhooks and digital products.
mcp_notes: Official systeme.io MCP server authenticated with an MCP key; included in all plans per vendor page.
blocker_detail: No approval or payment gate stated; API plan eligibility not explicitly confirmed.

evidence.quote: API keys are unique identifiers that authenticate requests to our public API.
Click on your profile picture and select Settings (1). In the left menu, click MCP & API keys (2).
Programmatically create new webhooks to receive real-time notifications, retrieve lists of your existing webhooks, and remove webhooks that are no longer needed.
The MCP server is a powerful feature included in all systeme.io plans.

uncertainties: Public API plan requirement not explicitly stated; Free-plan access is inferred from MCP plan statement.
